Simulate background events

Source: R/rHawkes.R
sim_background_events.Rd

Simulate background events

Usage

sim_background_events(
  background_rate,
  time_window,
  spatial_region,
  covariate_columns = NULL
)

Arguments

background_rate

Vector of coefficients for the background covariates.

time_window

Numeric vector of length two giving the simulated time window.

spatial_region

sf object defining the simulation region.

covariate_columns

Optional character vector naming background covariates in spatial_region.

Value

A dataframe with generated background events.

Examples

spatial_region <- create_rectangular_sf(0, 10, 0, 10)
time_window <- c(0, 50)
background_rate <- -4

sim_background_events(background_rate, time_window, spatial_region)
